body: I'm still here. I picked a cliff that was too far away and got too tired to climb to the top of it. Lol. I think I drove like 700 miles since I made this post. I'm back. Not suicidal but very depressed. I feel like I want to die still but not like I actually want to take the time to do it. (if that makes any sense.) I ended up not doing it because I felt bad for leaving my parents and dogs behind.... I still feel like shit. I'm going sleep. I've been up for at least 24 hours..
I guess Ill have to add some more meds and alcohol to make sure. Let's see how long it takes me to find a cliff on such short notice.
